scenes.title: Start with a local image
scenes.caption: The imported illustration is synthetic. This final-build screenshot shows the original proportions.
scenes.observed: Actual final APK resumed/imported state; source was imported through SAF before a license/source-link-only rebuild. Frames01–06 are deliberately not used.

scenes.title: Choose a square crop
scenes.caption: A centered 1:1 crop uses Telegram’s retained crop geometry. The source file stays unchanged.
scenes.observed: Actual square1:1 preset and square preview, after tapping crop selector.

scenes.title: Turn the frame
scenes.caption: One quarter turn from the Rotate 90° control. The image shown is the app’s real preview.
scenes.observed: Actual90degree rotation screenshot; source image clockwise rotated in square preview.

scenes.title: Mirror the image
scenes.caption: Mirror the rotated frame. Next, return upright and unmirrored for the final edit.
scenes.observed: Actual rotated-and-mirrored screenshot with Unmirror control. Subsequent UI actions12/13 restore rotation0 and mirrorfalse.

scenes.title: Adjust Enhance
scenes.caption: Back upright and unmirrored: Enhance 45 through Telegram’s retained rendering pipeline.
scenes.observed: Actual scrolled controls show Enhance 45,Exposure0 and square crop; image returned upright/unmirrored.

scenes.title: Add exposure
scenes.caption: Set Exposure 20 while retaining Enhance 45. The preview is the app’s actual rendered output.
scenes.observed: Actual scrolled controls show Enhance 45 and Exposure 20; final tested settings.

scenes.title: Save through Android
scenes.caption: Choose a destination and filename in Android’s document picker. Export an ordinary PNG.
scenes.observed: Actual Android create-document picker from final app; subsequent recorded Save and completion states confirm export.

scenes.title: The PNG is saved
scenes.caption: Actual output: 960 × 960 pixels. Independently decoded, with no EXIF or text metadata.
scenes.observed: Actual PNG saved960×960 status; independently inspected exported first.png and metadata chunks.

scenes.title: Pick up where you left off
scenes.caption: Force-stop, reopen: the imported image and saved adjustments return.
scenes.observed: Recorded force-stop/start action followed by final APK screenshot; subsequent re-export verifies retained output.

scenes.title: Export the same result
scenes.caption: The second 960 × 960 PNG is byte-identical to the first. The adjustments are retained.
scenes.observed: Actual second export confirmation, independent binary and pixel comparison passed with identical SHA256.

scenes.title: Keep settings simple

scenes.observed: Actual settings dialog shows System appearance and2048-pixel maximum export edge; no alteration claimed.
